d: In this special report, Firstpost explores how Indian American philanthropists are transforming lives across India. From funding medical research and strengthening healthcare to supporting education, rural development and environmental conservation, their contributions are making a difference in communities across the country. Meet donors who are giving back to the institutions and hometowns that shaped their lives, and discover how philanthropy is evolving from individual acts of charity into organised, long-term initiatives. Prepared in collaboration with The American Bazaar, the report…
